tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')

# merge current type info
cur = u.merge(c[['instance_type','family','vcpu','memory_gib','hourly_usd']], on='instance_type', suffixes=('','_cur'))

results=[]
for _,row in cur.iterrows():
    req_v = row['vcpu'] * row['p95_cpu_pct']/100 / 0.7
    req_m = row['memory_gib'] * row['p95_mem_pct']/100 / 0.8
    fam = c[(c['family']==row['family']) & (c['vcpu']>=req_v) & (c['memory_gib']>=req_m)]
    if len(fam)==0:
        rec = row['instance_type']
    else:
        rec = fam.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0]['instance_type']
    rec_cost = c[c['instance_type']==rec]['hourly_usd'].iloc[0]*730
    cur_cost = row['hourly_usd']*730
    results.append((row['instance_id'], rec, cur_cost, rec_cost))

df = pd.DataFrame(results, columns=['id','rec','cur_cost','rec_cost'])
under = df[df['rec_cost'] > df['cur_cost']]
print(under)
